name: Can I repair a leaking bathroom faucet myself, or should I call a professional?

mainEntity.name: Can I repair a leaking bathroom faucet myself, or should I call a professional?

acceptedAnswer.text: While minor faucet repairs, like replacing a simple washer, might be attempted by a homeowner with basic plumbing knowledge, more complex issues often require professional expertise. Attempting a repair without the right tools or experience can sometimes worsen the problem, leading to more significant damage or costly subsequent repairs. CG Plumbing Solutions recommends calling a professional for leaks involving internal cartridge replacement, persistent drips, or any issue that impacts water pressure, as our experienced technicians can efficiently diagnose and resolve these with appropriate parts and techniques.
acceptedAnswer.description: Minor repairs can be DIY, but complex issues like cartridge replacement or persistent leaks are best handled by a professional to avoid further damage.
